import subprocess,re
from pathlib import Path
files=[x for x in subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only','-z']).decode().split('\0') if x]
patterns=[rb'\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{25,}',rb'\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}',rb'-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----']
flagged=[]
for name in files:
 p=Path(name)
 if p.is_file() and p.suffix not in ['.png','.jpg','.wasm']:
  if any(re.search(pattern,p.read_bytes()) for pattern in patterns):flagged.append(name)
print({'stagedFiles':len(files),'credentialPatternFiles':flagged})
if flagged:raise SystemExit(1)
